name: Any chat assistant without skills (instruction kit)

surfaces.name: Instruction kit for project instructions, custom GPTs, Gems, spaces and similar
steps: Paste INSTRUCTIONS.md into the assistant's custom instructions (project, GPT, Gem or space).
Attach the files in knowledge/ where the assistant accepts reference files.
Expect labelled estimates, not measurements: see the capability table.

prerequisites: An assistant that accepts custom instructions

install.evidence: kit built; INSTRUCTIONS.md length checked against the 8,000-character custom-GPT limit; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#instruction-kit

invocation.evidence: the kit was not pasted into a live assistant from the build environment
